# Written by `msbctl host kandev install`. One pass of the Kandev reaper:
# destroys Kandev sandboxes past their expiry, cleans up stuck creates and
# orphans. Run by msb-kandev-reap.timer; it exits after each pass.
[Unit]
Description=msb-manager: reap expired Kandev sandboxes

[Service]
Type=oneshot
Environment=PATH=<TMP>/home/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin
ExecStart=/opt/msb/bin/msbctl host kandev reap
